question: What did DJ Kool Herc notice dancers doing at Bronx parties in 1973 that set hip hop going?
answer: They waited for the break, the few bars where the band dropped out and only the drums played, and danced hardest then. Herc bought two copies of the same record and switched between two turntables, replaying the break again and again. He called it the merry-go-round. Dancers and rappers filled the endless break.
move: Watch what people respond to most, then give them more of only that.
ask: Which part of my work do people light up at, and could I give them more of it?
reference: Chang, Can't Stop Won't Stop: A History of the Hip-Hop Generation, St. Martin's Press, 2005
